objectives: Resolve the open architecture forks that gate downstream build: Data Space/Data Share topology (AF3/G0402), identity-resolution grain for household-level Acxiom attributes (AF4/G0303), Pinterest/TikTok connector-tier classification (G0501), Braze connection direction and open-time render mechanism (G0702/G0703), and the MCP Next root-cause audit scope (G0101).
success_criteria: AF3/AF4 architecture decisions ratified and documented; MCP Next root-cause audit complete and scoped; connector-tier and Braze-pattern forks closed or explicitly deferred with an owner named.
dependencies: None — this phase gates everything downstream.
risks: G0101, G0303, G0402, G0501, G0702, G0703 — any of these left unresolved past this phase pushes rebuild risk onto E03/E04 per G0403.

objectives: Stand up Data 360 and sync the 4 BigQuery Customer Data Mesh tables (bi_customer_account, bi_customer_storefront, bi_visit, bi_email_daily_summary); land identity resolution and Data Space topology per the Phase 0 decisions.
success_criteria: 4 tables syncing via the confirmed per-table pattern (Zero Copy / ingestion / hybrid); identity resolution live; Data Space topology matches the AF3 decision.
risks: G0202 (per-table pattern), G0203 (Zero Copy volume ceiling), G0204 (suppression-field delete semantics), G0206 (identity resolution), G0209 (lower-environment BigQuery connectivity).

objectives: Layer Acxiom's ~39-attribute set onto Data 360 customer records across all 3 brands at the resolved identity grain, then activate identity-resolved, enriched segments into MCP (scheduled audiences, value segmentation, lifecycle targeting; near-real-time and cross-entity sub-types pending AF3/AF4 confirmation).
success_criteria: Acxiom attributes land on Unified Individual records across BBY US, Overstock, BuyBuyBaby with suppression/compliance handling; MCP activation live for scheduled/value/lifecycle segments.
dependencies: depends on: E02 — Acxiom enrichment and MCP activation both need Data 360's identity resolution and record structure in place first.
risks: G0301, G0303, G0306, G0307 (enrichment); G0401 (near-real-time vs. async-only activation), G0402 (cross-entity vs. Data Space isolation), G0403 (sequencing risk), G0406 (no historical backfill).

objectives: Activate Data 360 segments to the 5 ad platforms (Google Ads, Facebook, Criteo, Pinterest, TikTok) and build the 10 web experience use cases (beacon/catalog-feed setup, person-record enrichment, 5 named campaigns).
success_criteria: 5 ad platforms receiving segments via the confirmed connector tier per platform; 10 web use cases live across 3 brand surfaces.
dependencies: depends on: E02, E03 — both consume the Data 360 foundation and Acxiom-enriched segments built in Phases 1-2.
risks: G0501 (Pinterest/TikTok connector tier), G0503/G0505 (CPRA designation + suppression enforcement), G0602 (catalog-feed ingestion path), G0604 (MCP-vs-Data 360 decisioning split), G0605 (income-based pricing legal exposure).

objectives: Build and launch the 7 brand-neutral email use cases, including the mortgage-follow-up open-time-content use case that hands content/data to Braze.
success_criteria: 7 email use cases live; Braze connection built and operating per the Phase 0 connection-pattern decision.
dependencies: depends on: E02, E03 — email personalization draws on the same Data 360 foundation and enrichment layer.
risks: G0701 (6 of 7 use cases un-itemized at discovery time), G0702/G0703 (Braze connection pattern + open-time render mechanism), G0704 (ongoing connection-maintenance model), G0707 (Braze credential/contract access — external dependency against this schedule).

objectives: Audit and fix the live BBY US/Overstock MCP implementation; bring BuyBuyBaby onto the modern Interactions SDK → Data 360 Web Connector pattern. Runs concurrently with Phases 1-4, matching the internal staffing draft's own two-track schedule.
success_criteria: Root-cause defects on BBY US/Overstock remediated; BuyBuyBaby net-new instrumentation live.
dependencies: Phase 0 architecture decisions (cross-track identity-mapping call, G0102).
risks: G0101 (no root-cause defect list), G0102 (identity-mapping owner unassigned), G0104 (holiday change-freeze risk), G0109 (instrumentation-approach consistency across brands).
